decisions.reason: The manual laser workstation line extends the core laser offer and has stayed on the website for two years, and the growing, investing firm has the slack to carry it even though its results are only modestly visible.
The thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core business, has kept its own page through 2024, and shows no sign of falling short of aspirations.
The piezo inkjet printer fits the firm's strategy of matching technologies to surfaces, has been presented consistently, and gives no shortfall signal that would prompt search for alternatives.
The industrial laser marking line is the home-page flagship and central to the firm's direction, so dropping it within a year is very unlikely.
The newly launched laser cabin complements the flagship laser line, and with ample slack the firm will give it time to meet aspirations.
The lubricant printing system won a trade fair award, a result that meets or exceeds aspirations and supports keeping it in a specialised niche.
